expectation: Membrane/cytoplasmic stain on scattered macrophages (also some DCs and endothelium), a minority of cells, in gut lamina propria and submucosa as single cells or small clusters, not on epithelium. Mostly a subset of CD163+ cells.
observed: A: diffuse yellow haze over the whole tissue, with speckle in the lamina propria. B/C: a bright rim on the epithelial apical edge and diffuse haze elsewhere. D: one bright granular cell. E: CD206 patches overlap CD163 cells (white in the merge), but green speckle also lies on CD163-negative tissue.
why: Cells match the CD163 macrophage partner, but there is high background haze and an epithelial-edge signal that is not cell-specific.
